message.content:
LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed: top-left causal chain, top-right recorded series, bottom-left bit-pattern strip, and bottom-right state card.
SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss) in the legend. However, the plot area is effectively empty of data lines or points; only a flat orange baseline is visible near 0.1. The purple animated marker is visible at the top-left of the plot area (approx 0.02, 0.98). The overall trend is flat/zero for the recorded data.
TEXT: Step number is 58 (of 199). w value is 1.5134968757629395. Loss is 3.171363716812338e-07. FPS readout is "24 FPS drawn" (top-right of series panel) and "32 FPS drawn" (state card header). Bit count is "bits changed 10 of 32".
BITS: There are 32 bit squares drawn in the strip. The orange squares (representing changed bits) are located at positions 14, 15, 16, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 29, and 30 (0-indexed from left). The hex word is readable as 0x3FC1BA44.
DEFECTS: The primary defect is that the line plot in the top-right panel contains no visible data series despite the legend; the graph area is nearly blank except for the marker and a baseline. Additionally, the text in the state card and the bit-strip labels is extremely small and difficult to read without zooming.
VERDICT: FAIL (The dashboard frame fails to render the core data series in the live plot, making the "recorded series" panel non-functional as a visualization tool.)
